So to test the 512 physical limit I need continuations: e.g. 400 fields each with 2 continuation lines → physical = 1200.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='t_syntax.py'
s=open(p).read()
old_lines = [l for l in s.split("\n") if l.startswith('C("513 phys') or l.startswith('C("512 phys') or l.startswith('C("logical over') or l.startswith('C("logical max ok') or l.startswith('C("at length ok')]
for l in old_lines: s = s.replace(l, '')
s = s.replace('''C("512 phys incl cl"''', '''C("512 phys incl cl"''')
extra = '''
# physical/logical line limits with continuations
def phys_raw(nphys):
    # nphys counts physical header lines: 5 required fields + one big folded field
    base = "MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0\\r\\nFrom: %s\\r\\nTo: <sip:i@r.t>\\r\\nCall-ID: c\\r\\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\\r\\nX: 1\\r\\n" % EM
    cont = " \\r\\n" * (nphys - 5)
    return base + cont + "Content-Length: 0\\r\\n\\r\\n"
C("phys 512 ok", sub(one(raw=phys_raw(512)), "status"), "accept")
C("phys 513 bad", one(raw=phys_raw(513)), E)
def log_raw(nlog):
    base = "MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0\\r\\nFrom: %s\\r\\nTo: <sip:i@r.t>\\r\\nCall-ID: c\\r\\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\\r\\n" % EM
    return base + "".join("Y%d: v\\r\\n" % k for k in range(nlog - 4)) + "Content-Length: 0\\r\\n\\r\\n"
C("log 128 ok", sub(one(raw=log_raw(128)), "status"), "accept")
C("log 129 bad", one(raw=log_raw(129)), E)
base_big = "MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0\\r\\nFrom: %s\\r\\nTo: <sip:i@r.t>\\r\\nCall-ID: c\\r\\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\\r\\n" % EM
_body = "x" * (32768 - len(base_big) - len("Content-Length: 0\\r\\n\\r\\n"))
_exact = base_big + "Content-Length: %d\\r\\n\\r\\n" % len(_body) + _body
C("exact 32768 ok", sub(one(raw=_exact), "status"), "accept")
C("32769 bad", one(raw=_exact + "x"), E)
'''
s = s + extra
open(p,'w').write(s)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 t_syntax.py 2>&1 | tail -20
